_readme: Hand-written HSK levels for words the 2025 list leaves out (or levels you want to change). Keys starting with _ are ignored. The vocab file supplies each word's readings and meanings; a word the file doesn't have at all must give its own "pinyin" (numeric) and "meanings" (list), like 儿 below. load_hsk_lists.py prints every override it applies.

没.why: 没有 is HSK 1; 没 alone is missing from the 2025 list

天.why: 今天/明天/天气 are HSK 1; check the loader output -- remove if the 2025 list already has it

们.why: 我们/你们 are HSK 1; check the loader output -- remove if the 2025 list already has it

meanings: erhua suffix, makes the syllable end in -r (玩儿, 一点儿, 哪儿)
儿.why: erhua suffix; 哪儿/这儿 are HSK 1. Not an entry of its own in the vocab file, so its pinyin and meanings are given here

杯.why: measure word for drinks (一杯水); 杯子 is HSK 1

觉.why: the 觉 of 睡觉 (HSK 1), which splits: 睡了一觉

英语.why: English; as basic as 汉语/中文 (HSK 1)

英文.why: English; as basic as 汉语/中文 (HSK 1)
